properties.note: GOVERNED_BY and deliberately NOT REALIZES. This script delivers no product capability — it ran once, on 2026-08-07, to execute dec:backlog-is-retired, and asserting that it realizes something would be the false claim this project treats as a defect. It is committed rather than discarded because its CLASSIFY table is the judgement half of the migration: which of the four types each retired row became, and which node it was attached to. That mapping exists nowhere else, and without it 'why is BL-140 a defect against cmp:detect' is unanswerable. The prose it moved came from the row verbatim; only the routing was decided, and this file is where that decision is legible.
